basic_info.description: Nestled in the vibrant Cow Hollow neighborhood & A Private GARAGE.  2036 Greenwich welcomes you to a perfect blend of classic Edwardian charm and modern sophistication. This thoughtfully designed Top-Floor 2 Bedroom condo has undergone an extensive remodel in with seismic and structural improvements. The open concept layout seamlessly integrates the living, dining, and chef's kitchen, providing a fluid and inviting space for both everyday living and entertaining. The living room has a wine fridge & kegerator just waiting to impress your guests. The kitchen boasts newer cabinets, quartz countertops and stainless steel Thermador appliances. Whether you're a culinary enthusiast or just love hosting gatherings, this space caters to your every need. Designer paint colors and hardwood floors flow throughout. Descend to the lower level, where you'll discover a car enthusiasts’ private garage with ample storage, built-in cabinets and epoxy finished floors. The backyard ensures you will have the space to grill and relax at home. The best location in the city being centrally located at the crossroads of Union, Fillmore and Chestnut Street, close to local shopping, dining, renowned national parks, beaches, the historic Presidio and transportation are just out your doorstep.
